Structured concurrency in Swift

How do I run two async calls concurrently?

Use a task group when you need all results:

await withTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
	for i in 1...3 { group.addTask { await work(i) } }
}

What happens if one throws?

Thinking

Task groups propagate the first error and cancel the rest.

The first thrown error propagates; the remaining child tasks are cancelled.
